$description: Component index from Figma 'UI/UX Library' pages and the Guideline reference set. 'spec' fields come from the Guideline; components without a spec are listed from the Library and still need detail extraction.

components.name: status-bar
components.spec: Floats over scene and panel; transparent root with one full-width scrim. Content starts under the 96 top line.

components.name: dock
components.spec: App tiles 54 icon, radius 14, bg component/app-tile-bg. Temperature steppers: chevron 64, gap space/10, value 44.

components.name: scene-panel
components.spec: Full-bleed left surface; shows live results of settings (PT-01).

components.name: app-panel
components.spec: Full-bleed right surface, square corners, bg/panel.

components.name: search
components.spec: Radius 20, icon stroke 3, leading inset 20, icon-to-text gap 12. Field to list gap 12 (history) / 32 (results).

components.name: poi-row
components.spec: Results 20 px top/bottom, history 16 px; 8 px left, 4 px right. Primary ink for available count and price; secondary for slash, total, unit, icon. Go and Add waypoint as adjacent 68 × 68 targets.

components.name: button
components.spec: Dialogs and popups only. Label min width M 116 · S 100.

components.name: toggle-group
components.spec: Rounded rectangle, radius track 16 › segment 12. Label 26/36. Selected = fill/selected, no stroke.

components.name: switch
components.spec: The only pill shape. On = accent/fill.

components.name: list-card
components.spec: bg/card, radius 20, 12 px vertical padding; rows slot (list-row, choice-row); border/panel 2 px inside.

components.name: settings-page
components.spec: Content slot of list-header + list-card sections; side-nav-item exposed for selection.

components.name: side-nav
components.spec: 9 side-nav-items in two groups, no labels, group gap 38.

screens.name: key-screen-map
screens.content: Scene: speed, lanes, ego car. Map: route, puck, maneuver card, map controls, ETA.

screens.name: settings
screens.content: side-nav (no labels) + list-header + list-card sections; scene shows the live result.
